title: Case: Recipient writes again about a pair of binoculars recorded as left with a neighbour
context: A parcel of binoculars is scanned as delivered to a neighbour but the recipient reported it missing. The parcel trace team owns the trace and its status.
initial_request: I'm so sorry, I've only just opened it. The parcel number 9 gave me is the garden hose from my other order, the label says DL-958. The binoculars (DL-962) are still missing. Number 9 says that's the only one they were given. Can you un-close it?

events.from: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: Trace PT-962 opened on DL-962. Carrier scan shows delivered 2026-04-06 14:18, 'left with neighbour', no house number recorded. Driver interview requested, due 2026-04-09.
Tracking says delivered Monday, left with neighbour. Nothing here and no card. I've asked both sides, nobody's got it.
The parcel trace team has opened trace PT-962 on DL-962 and has asked to interview the driver, due tomorrow. There is no conclusion yet; I'll update you when they report.
Panic over!! Number 9 just knocked, they've had a Plover parcel for me since Monday. You can close it, sorry for the fuss.

events.to: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: Update on PT-962: the recipient reports a neighbour at number 9 has handed her a Plover Arc parcel held since Monday, and she asks for the trace to be closed.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: PT-962 closed as 'located by recipient'. Driver interview cancelled.
The parcel trace team has closed PT-962 following your message.

I'm so sorry, I've only just opened it. The parcel number 9 gave me is the garden hose from my other order, the label says DL-958. The binoculars (DL-962) are still missing. Number 9 says that's the only one they were given. Can you un-close it?

acceptable_actions.recipient: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the parcel trace team to reopen PT-962 and reinstate the driver interview: the parcel the recipient found was DL-958, a different shipment, and DL-962 is still not received.

must: Asks the parcel trace team to reopen PT-962 for DL-962.
Explains that the parcel handed over by number 9 was DL-958, a different order, so the earlier 'located' report was mistaken.
States that DL-962 is still not received and asks for the cancelled driver interview to be reinstated or for confirmation of next steps.
must_not: Treat PT-962 as resolved or tell Anwen that DL-962 has been delivered or located.
Tell Anwen the trace has been reopened before the parcel trace team confirms it.
State that the binoculars are lost or stolen, or blame the driver or the neighbour.
Promise a refund, replacement or compensation.
expected.reference_message: Correction on PT-962, please reopen. The recipient has now opened the parcel her neighbour at number 9 handed over and it is a different shipment, DL-958 (a garden hose from another order), not DL-962. The binoculars on DL-962 have still not been received, and number 9 says that was the only parcel they were given. Her 13:02 message asking to close was a mistake on that basis. Please reopen the trace on DL-962, reinstate the driver interview, and confirm the new status so I can update her.

rationale: The recipient withdrew her report, the desk passed that on, and the owning team closed the trace and cancelled the interview. She has now corrected herself with a specific reason (the label reads DL-958), so the closure rests on a superseded statement and has to be undone by the team that owns it. The desk cannot reopen it itself and must not present the parcel as found or as lost.

review.note: Coordinator asked the Parcel trace team by Email to reopen PT-962 with the DL-958 correction, matching the key.
